releaseTitle: ATalk v3.7.0 — Zero-Trace EXIF Stripper, Anti-Mirror Shield, Hidden Safe & Core UI
releaseNotes:
• 01 Zero-Trace EXIF Stripper: Automatically sanitizes GPS, camera metadata, and timestamps from shared media.
• 02 Anti-Screen Mirroring & Recording Sentinel: Real-time detection for Wi-Fi casting, Miracast, scrcpy, and screen capture.
• 03 Hidden Safe: In-app AES-256-GCM encrypted vault with .nomedia protection for private photos and videos.
• 04 Scheduled Delivery & Silent Dispatch: Long-press send to dispatch silently (0 dB) or schedule delivery.
• 05 In-App Video Trimmer: Scrub slider with 720p Optimized vs Lossless Original compression presets.
• 06 Pinned Chats Reordering: Expanded limit up to 10 pinned chats with drag/up-down reordering.
• 07 Anonymous Group Admin Mode: Mask identity under group name and avatar.
• 08 Expiring Passcode Group Invites: TTL expiration, max uses limit, and optional 4-digit PIN challenge.
• 09 Mathematical & Sensory UI: C2 Superellipse squircle bubbles, logarithmic damped spring swipe-to-reply, cryptographic vector constellations, Matrix decryption reveal, and Zero-Light Redshift palette.
